title: Built a 3D pixel art version of TLOU with opus 5.5
author: Sufficient_Nobody477

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Looks terrific. what does your art pipeline look like. looks more lo poly than pixel art.

replies.author: Sufficient_Nobody477
replies.body: I don’t have a pipeline yet, trying to make one by summarizing how I prompt for this. Basically I wanted a pixel style first, but it was not very ideal, so changed to a lo poly one, given some references image I found online.

comments.author: Lambisexual
comments.body:
That's cool. Were the character really made with just Opus in Blender? Cause they look quite clean. Would love to know how you prompted that.

As for the animations, you said you got them from Mixamo? Because a lot of them looks very tailor made, like the character jumping on the zombies back.

replies.author: Sufficient_Nobody477
replies.body: There are not that many complex tricks, just build and validate(both ai and human), collect feedback and repeat more iterations. Graphics improvements like this extent is something ai could definitely handle. As to animations yea it’s all mixamo files, maybe Claude did some tweak i don’t know, I need to check it to figure out 😂

replies.author: Lambisexual
replies.body: I'm surprised you managed to get Mixamo working rigs for characters made entirely by Opus in Blender. You didn't give it a base model to work with or used some other special thing?

replies.author: Sufficient_Nobody477
replies.body: I only used a reference image, nothing else special here. Maybe because the camera is far? When drawing near, the models still have some flaws and have space to be further improved, which I’m not sure whether opus could do more or not.
